causal_assessment.conclusion: Empirical support confirmed: Neglected attention (Z < -0.5) significantly correlates with constraint drop and clinical invariant violations. However, attention weight is NOT proof of use; reasoning errors can occur even under sufficient attention.
known_limitations: Attention mass is a necessary precondition, not a guarantee of factual adherence.
Non-linear threshold: Z-scores between -0.5 and +0.5 exhibit high variance in model adherence.
Short documents with low distractors demonstrate ceiling effects where low Z may still recall correctly.
